text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the window, the incoming breeze was slightly chilly.
It won't be long until... the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether Almond Eye reaches 8 turf G1 victories
or stumbles here... is finally about to be decided.
choice_data_list: (I've prepared as best I can. And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because I know her strength
that the "what-ifs" won't leave my head.
Because in a race—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, the sky looks so high and vast today.
――Before training, would you like to take a short walk?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: We've walked quite a long way...!
choice_data_list: We managed to find a nice cafe, too.
We found a nice cafe too, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I've been looking for some delicious
rooibos tea. Let's go again sometime!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I often come around here
even after training, so...—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I just remembered.
About what happened right after the Debut Race."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I kept getting late starts in the mock races, but...
we managed to fix it, and this is where you and I shouted together, wasn't it?
choice_data_list: Ah, that did happen, didn't it?
Yeah, that did happen, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Right?! You and I have...
truly talked about so many things.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Before the Oka Sho, she even came asking for advice.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "You don't need to worry about what comes after." Hearing that let me give it everything I had!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It was my first Classic race, so I got a bit carried away...
But your words helped me get my head back in the game.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"When you told me ‘Don't let the cheers swallow you up,’
I was surprised. You gave me a perspective I never had!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It was my first Classic race, so I got a bit carried away...
But your words helped me get my head back in the game.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You boldly declared that we'd achieve a complete victory over Lala.
You gave me such a strong push forward!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It was my first Classic race, so I got a bit carried away...
But your words helped me get my head back in the game.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why are you reacting like that?!
You helped me out so much, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Even when I collapsed—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: “You looked me right in the eye and told me you wanted to help me, didn't you?”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I was so... grateful for that sentiment.
Because it made me truly realize
that you were standing right beside me."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I was really feeling down, you know? But your feelings gave me the courage to stand back up.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Saying "I was worried about letting go"...
Your warmth came from truly caring about me.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Your tone sounded so genuine...
that it made my heart skip a beat.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I was really feeling down, you know? But your feelings gave me the courage to stand back up.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You could say you wanted to fight alongside me
with a straight face... It really soothed my heart back then.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that I wasn't alone...
Nothing had ever been more reassuring than that moment.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I was really feeling down, you know? But your feelings gave me the courage to stand back up.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—You were always right there
by my side.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to give my strength
to the current you, too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You've been thinking about the next race all along, haven't you?
Worrying about what will happen if you can't make me win..."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: In other words, you doubt my power—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...that's not it at all, is it!
You actually believe in me.
Ever since the Make Debut, you always have..."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Even so, I can't help thinking about it...
because "nothing is certain in a race."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The exact origin of that maxim goes like this:
"There are no absolutes in racing, but there is an absolute in Symboli Rudolf"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It perfectly reflects the peerless strength of the "Emperor."
And yet――even for her...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —I believe in myself 100%.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's why you're here...
keeping an eye out for any 'worst-case scenarios.'

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because they believe in me unconditionally—
I find myself looking at even the slightest possibility.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
But you know. Even so...
—I'll be just fine!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Because we... we've worked so hard together, haven't we?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I think it was during the Shuka Sho
that I first strongly realized it. Because—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Sharing victory together was...
so, so much better than being alone!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Why do you think?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Geez, figure it out already!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's because it was a victory we grabbed
after getting stronger together... right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "You didn't give in to yourself either; you worked hard... and grew strong. That's why we could share this."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Because you were always pushing me forward...
Because there are two of us—we are strong!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My eyes grew hot. To think she had
cherished our memories together this much—
choice_data_list: (I was able to be such a help after all—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
..."Umamusume run carrying everyone's wishes,"
was that it?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It didn't really click with me back then. But...
if it's a story about "you and me," I understand.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: The very first wish you made for me—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want to see a sight I've never seen before.
...I wondered what kind of sight that would be, though.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure—it's everything
that lies ahead of wherever I run.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want to show you too.
If our two wills can become one—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —I can win.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“I want you to make my dream come true.
...I know it seemed like a strange request, though.”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Having seen your smile all this time, now I understand.
Truly, you just—
want me to win!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want to make it come true with you too.
If our two prayers can become one—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —I can win.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I want to keep supporting you forever"...
To think she'd say that, when really, I'm the one who should be asking.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"You've supported me all the way to this day...
I didn't make it here alone.
—I came here with you."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I want you to support me too.
If our mutual trust can become one—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —I can win.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if there are any absolutes.
I'm well aware of that. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I... absolutely want to win.
Together with you—I want to win!!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
...What about you?
choice_data_list: Of course, I want to win—with you!
Of course, I want to win—with you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. In that case, we will—share the ultimate victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The dark shadow that had fallen over their hearts completely vanished.
All that remained was their resolve to win together.
